scopes.latency: Go 256 logarithmic buckets; pooled single-request quantiles are inclusive upper bounds, at most 12.5% plus 1us; bulk quantiles are per-round call-latency bounds and are never pooled
scopes.commands: owned MongoDB serverStatus deltas for the seven selected business command types; excludes hello, serverStatus and other command types; Elasticsearch unavailable
scopes.prometheus_cpu: Weir process_cpu_seconds_total difference between snapshots wrapping the timed stage, including the short barrier/collection window; divided by successful business records
scopes.ps_cpu: sampling estimate only: cumulative ps CPU differences over valid observed intervals, divided by those intervals; Linux ps CPU is quantized at approximately one second; no CPU/op or small cost-benefit claim
scopes.memory: sampled maxima; Weir/client memory is ps RSS; Docker database memory is container memory usage, not database-process RSS; sums of individual PID peaks are not simultaneous peaks
scopes.capacity: same-host clients and Weir, owned database with inspected CPU quota; CPU saturation and next-level plateau do not establish production capacity or uncached/disk-bound performance
